##### Project general facts

Omoria Private Residences is an ultra-luxury boutique coastal development that introduces a new standard of refined living, combining world-class hospitality with private residential comfort. Developed by Innovate Living, the project represents a unique concept of curated lifestyle, where every detail is designed to deliver exclusivity, privacy, and sophistication. The development offers a limited collection of bespoke residences, including 1 to 4-bedroom suites, expansive duplexes, and a signature penthouse, all complemented by generous layouts and panoramic sea views that create a serene, resort-like atmosphere.

The project is centered around holistic well-being and elevated everyday living, offering an exceptional range of amenities tailored to modern luxury lifestyles. Residents can enjoy an infinity pool overlooking the sea, a state-of-the-art fitness center with a dedicated Pilates studio, a full-service wellness spa with advanced treatments, and a private cinema. The development also features fine-dining restaurants, a sea-view padel court, luxury retail, and exclusive lounge and library spaces, alongside personalized services such as health concierge, biohacking programs, and bespoke hospitality offerings that redefine residential comfort.

Each residence is meticulously crafted with bespoke Italian furniture, premium materials, and sophisticated finishes that reflect timeless elegance and contemporary design. Interiors feature natural stone, travertine, bronze accents, and warm wood textures, complemented by fully equipped kitchens and carefully curated fittings from leading international brands. Designed to provide both comfort and aesthetic excellence, the homes seamlessly blend functionality with artistry, while offering residents a fully serviced living experience with à la carte hospitality, ensuring effortless luxury in every aspect of daily life.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Islands is a visionary development that epitomizes the luxurious and innovative spirit of Dubai. Strategically located along the coast, this ambitious project features a collection of five man-made islands designed to offer a blend of residential, commercial, and leisure spaces. Each island is meticulously planned to provide a unique living experience, surrounded by pristine beaches, lush landscapes, and crystal-clear waters.

The islands are connected to the mainland via well-developed infrastructure, ensuring seamless access to the rest of the city. This prime location allows residents and visitors to enjoy the tranquility of island life while being just a short drive away from Dubai's bustling urban centers, including the iconic landmarks and vibrant districts such as Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and Palm Jumeirah. The development includes a range of upscale amenities, including luxury hotels, gourmet dining options, high-end retail outlets, and world-class recreational facilities.

Dubai Islands is designed to cater to a diverse array of lifestyles, offering everything from serene residential communities to dynamic entertainment hubs. The project emphasizes sustainability and innovation, incorporating green building practices and advanced technologies to create a harmonious and eco-friendly environment. With its stunning natural beauty, exceptional amenities, and strategic location, Dubai Islands stands as a premier destination for those seeking an unparalleled lifestyle in one of the world's most dynamic cities.
